specs.title: The detail shows no wireframe or design affordance
No acceptance gate — the detail is the two columns, nothing to accept
The detail offers a three-view toggle — Focus reads one requirement per page in two containers
The proof is scannable as frames, not only as video — a strip of stills per checked value
A finished run refreshes the board in place — no reload, the panel stays (dispatch R7)
hudCheck asserts the value it paints — a mismatch throws, a match does not

note: a real match — got X · expected X

specs.title: Searching requirement text hides groups that miss
A test opens to its evidence and the log opens in a window
The guide opens as manager and staff — without, then with
Acts 1 and 2 play once, hold, and stand still under reduced motion
The walkthrough steps on click and holds — never auto-advances
A deep-linked skill URL shows the skill detail on cold load
The guide ends with the derived next action, and there is no rail
R2 — both positions are shown in full, each naming where it came from
R3 — the tool never picks: resolving is refused until you choose a side
R4 — resolving records which side lost, stays on Open, and offers the rewrite
R5 — a decision survives a rescan that reorders and swaps the sides
R5 — undo puts a settled conflict back, and the scanner is never asked to pick
R1/R2 — the panel opens on the click and streams the job while it runs
R4 — a person's second run takes over the running one: accepted, not refused
R4 — a run may nest inside the run driving it, and nesting is bounded
running one screen leaves every other screen's E2E result standing
R6/R8 — a run saves its whole log, and records every test case on its own
R8 — a run that matched no test is recorded as an error, never 0 of 0 passing
R8 — running ONE case leaves every other case's steps and log standing
R8 — a case keeps a LOG HISTORY, folded across runs
R8 — EVERY case that has run can expand its steps, not only the one you clicked
R7 — the run panel offers no background run
R7 — the panel and its log stay on screen after the run ends
R5 — cancel stops the job, and cancelling nothing is refused not crashed
R1 — the form persists what cannot be guessed, and reads it back
R1 — the setup cards are single-column blocks, not the home two-column grid
R1 — start mode saves backend and frontend, in order
R3 — a drafted PRD lands as a guess: one CARD, visibly a guess and waiting, with no gate
R4 — nothing found is the greenfield case: no rows, a prompt to write the first PRD
R6 — voice-over is a saved, per-project switch, off by default
R6 — the switch is disabled until piper is ready, with a copyable install helper
R5 — rerunning marks new routes new and leaves a settled row alone
